title: C: audit lichen_hash_32 calls for byte order and identifier width
description:
Per spec 2a.10.7, verify all lichen_hash_32 calls use:
- Network byte order (big-endian) for multi-byte inputs
- Full 16-byte DODAG ID where applicable (not truncated to 8 bytes)
Check: link/hash32.c, link/sync_hop.c, link/link_ctx.c, link/tdma.c
Verify sync_hop seed derivation if it comes from DODAG ID.
